title: SB527 (2023 Regular): Relating to minimum age restrictions in places of public accommodation.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2023R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/SB527/Introduced; sha256 a2723711d78a974a9035cc872c11f7438c10e83372bd010c6194a7d36a215ea6)
provenance.note: Introduced version (as filed). The exemption from the age-discrimination law exists only to carry out the gun age rule. SECTION 3 makes the change apply to pending cases. No votes recorded.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new): (1) A gun dealer, a person transferring a firearm, a firearm accessory, ammunition or an ammunition component at a gun show, or a business engaged in repairing or servicing a firearm, may establish a minimum age of 21 years for the purchase of firearms, firearm accessories, ammunition or ammunition components or for the repair or service of a firearm.
SECTION 2 (ORS 659A.403): (d) A gun dealer or person transferring a firearm, a firearm accessory, ammunition or an ammunition component at a gun show from enforcing minimum age restrictions of 21 years, pursuant to section 1 of this 2023 Act, on the purchase of firearms, firearm accessories, ammunition or ammunition components; or
SECTION 2 (ORS 659A.403): (e) A business engaged in the repairing and servicing of firearms from enforcing minimum age restrictions of 21 years, pursuant to section 1 of this 2023 Act, for the repair or service of a firearm.
